#!name=网易有道词典
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0537 / 网易有道词典 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0377 / 网易有道词典去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/translateTab/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api-overmind\.youdao\.com\/openapi\/get\/luna\/dict\/dict-mobile\/prod\/dictCommonConfig/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cdke\.youdao\.com\/course3\/recommend\/dict\/startup/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/commonsearch/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/vip\/activity\/couponinfo/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/dictusertask\/system/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dictvip-business\.youdao\.com\/home\/ad/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/oimage([a-z])([0-9])\.ydstatic\.com\/.+adpublish/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/oimage\w\d\.ydstatic\.com\/image\?.+?=adpublish/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dsp-impr2\.youdao\.com\/adload/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/impservice\.dictapp\.youdao\.com\/imp\/request/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/oral\.youdao\.com\/oral\/adInfo/i then reject_img(200)

[Map Local]
^https:\/\/gorgon\.youdao\.com\/gorgon\/brand\/prefetch\.s\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/gorgon\.youdao\.com\/gorgon\/request\.s\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[Body Rewrite]
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/homepage\/toolbar\/get\? 'delpaths([["data","vipTag"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/translateTab\? 'delpaths([["data"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","popup"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","tab"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","searchSuggestList"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","newBanner"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","icon","promotionList"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","icon","iconList",1,"bubble"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","icon","iconList",2,"bubble"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/dict\.youdao\.com\/course\/tab\/home\? 'delpaths([["data","icon","iconList",8,"bubble"]])'

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% dict.youdao.com, api-overmind.youdao.com, cdke.youdao.com, dictvip-business.youdao.com, dsp-impr2.youdao.com, impservice.dictapp.youdao.com, oral.youdao.com, oimage*.ydstatic.com, gorgon.youdao.com
